scope: Isolated Windows fresh setup and rerun; not hosting or public launch acceptance
tested_source_state: Base public commit plus the two exact local corrections identified by normalized source hashes below; correction was not committed when this evidence was recorded.

original_public_setup.cause: Missing WP_INSTALLING let wp-load leave the fresh bootstrap before installation; subsequent failed WP-CLI actions were not checked and setup printed ready.

corrected_setup.first_run: Fresh empty installation from checked downloads and corrected scripts
corrected_setup.rerun: Existing native database bytes, every database table, users and private credential file stayed identical
corrected_setup.existing_install_helper: Explicit repeat installation refused with status 1; database, users and credentials remained identical

fixes: Bootstrap first installation with WP_INSTALLING and a temporary explicit loopback WP_SITEURL.
Check actual installation and every following WP-CLI action before reporting ready.
Restore temporary password/port environment variables in finally; do not print credentials.
State that no project content was seeded or published; WordPress creates its ordinary default content.
downloads: First original test downloaded each official pinned file; second fresh correction retest reused only those ZIP/PHAR bytes, rechecked by setup's same SHA-256 checks. No database or credentials were copied between clones.
isolation: Ignored fresh clones on port 8090; no server was started and primary port 8088 instance was untouched.
private_evidence: Full table and before/after snapshots remain ignored. Public evidence contains preservation results and source hashes only, not credential values or table contents.
